how: Paste Kularnava / Tantrasamuchaya excerpts here as tab objects. Ancient Sanskrit verses are public domain and go verbatim; modern commentary gets summarized only. Tabs merge after meru_tabs in-game automatically.

tabs.what: Kerala square sanctum (caturasra plan): laterite walls on a stone adhishthana plinth, timber band course, copper crown above. The deity's womb-house faces east.
tabs.how_in_game: Raise its walls, roof and kalasha in the temple plot phases; ring the bell at the sanctum door; guard its lamps through the storm-repair phase.
tabs.philosophy: The outermost gate leads stepwise inward; the center is small, dark and still.

tabs.what: East-facing square chathura-vimana in two talas: granite adhisthana mouldings, laterite pada with pilasters, 9-band prastara, hara aedicules (kuta/sala/panjara), upper tala, timber pyramidal roof and gilt copper stupi-kalasha. Scale runs padonatrikara (2.75 hastas) to 15 hastas in 8-angula steps; 1 hasta = 24 angulas.
tabs.how_in_game: Generated from spec/vishnu-dvitala.v1.json by ksetra_builder.gd; every member carries its rule provenance, inspectable via ProvenanceLookup.
tabs.philosophy: Height is measured order: base, wall and crown each know their share.
sources: Tantrasamuccaya Patala II v1 (Unni transl.), Vimarshini/Vivarana anchor

tabs.name_en: Yoni: facing and formula must agree
tabs.what: Temples from Ishana to Yama quarters take dhvaja-yoni and face west; the remaining quarters take go (vrisha)-yoni and face east. The installed idol's yoni must equal the prasada's yoni: east-facing Vishnu here is vrisha with vrisha idol.
tabs.how_in_game: Enforced fail-closed by KsetraSpecLoader (K-YONI-PAIR); a mismatched spec refuses to build.
tabs.philosophy: Door and deity share one orientation formula; neither is placed alone.
sources: Tantrasamuccaya Patala II v2 + commentaries (passage anchor)

tabs.what: Every generated member keeps rule ids: GAME OBJECT -> RULE -> KNOWLEDGE ENTITY -> SOURCE (work, patala, verse, layer). 269 rules gated; contradictions preserved, never merged.
tabs.how_in_game: ProvenanceLookup.chain_for() renders the chain for any built node; 23/23 spec nodes resolve in-engine.
tabs.philosophy: Never invent a rule; what cannot be sourced is marked SOURCE_REQUIRED, PARTIAL or OPEN.
